_comments: Runs Record Contract Renewal Outcomes hourly at five past. Hourly rather than daily because the
label turns over at midnight in the BUSINESS time zone, which is a different UTC hour per host and
per season; an hourly run records an expiry within an hour of it, whatever the zone.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip: two runs would update the same rows.
· MissedRunPolicy RunOnce: each run compares every contract, so one catch-up covers any gap.
Seeded Active: it writes only the label column, and only where the label is out of date.

fields.Name: Contracts — Record Renewal Outcomes (hourly)
fields.Description: Records NonRenewalOutcome on contracts whose end date has passed, so the renewal-risk label is stored rather than computed on every read.
